result.title: DROA-CLIPSeg: Prompt-Guided Thin Crack Segmentation in Low-Light Conditions
result.comment: Accepted at the 37th British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC 2026)
result.summary: Pavement crack segmentation under low light is degraded by reduced contrast, shadows, headlight glare, joints, stains, and wet seams. Existing crack segmentation methods mostly assume good illumination. Low-light enhancement methods improve visual quality, but they do not explicitly preserve crack topology. To address these limitations, we formulate low-light crack segmentation as a degradation-aware, prompt-grounded structural defect segmentation problem and propose DROA-CLIPSeg, a parameter-efficient framework that adapts a frozen CLIPSeg vision language backbone using two lightweight modules. QKV Low-Rank Adaptation is injected into the Q/K/V projections of the vision and text encoders to improve crack-specific image text alignment without backbone fine-tuning. The proposed Domain Residual Orthogonal Adapter (DROA) decomposes intermediate features into a dominant crack-domain branch, which captures recurring low-light crack patterns, and an orthogonal residual branch, which preserves faint, thin, and fragmented evidence usually suppressed by noise, shadow, or over-smoothing. We also introduce CrackLingo-9K and CrackLingo-12K, text augmented versions of Crack9k and Crack12k with crack-aware prompts. Training only approximately 1.93 M parameters, corresponding to 1.3% of the full model, DROA-CLIPSeg outperforms 9 zero-shot and 4 fine-tuned vision language baselines on both splits, generalises zero-shot to MVTec AD across textures and defect morphologies, and is supported by extensive ablations. Our source code is publicly available at https://github.com/VShuklacode/DROA-CLIPSeg

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DROA-CLIPSeg，在冻结的 CLIPSeg 视觉语言骨干上注入 QKV 低秩适配，并用领域残差正交适配器分解中间特征，实现低光照下细裂缝分割，同时构建带裂缝提示的文本增强数据集。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但其将特征分为主域分支与正交残差分支以保留微弱、细薄证据的做法，可能为 VLM 内部状态中视觉细节保留与信息坍缩提供可供核查的适配器设计线索。
